title: Grow & Protect: Insurance Logic
learningGoals: Define financial risk and its impact
Explain how insurance pools risk among many people
Identify common types of insurance in India

teachingScript.teacherLine: Insurance is like an umbrella. You don't enjoy carrying it on a sunny day, but you're very glad you have it when it rains!

data.title: The Insurance Umbrella
points: Premium: The small amount you pay monthly.
Risk: The chance of something bad happening.
Claim: When the company pays for the damage.

teachingScript.teacherLine: There are different umbrellas for different risks. Health insurance for hospital bills, Life insurance for your family, and Motor insurance for your car.

questionPool.questionText: The small amount you pay periodically to an insurance company is called a _____.
